# Facebook Followers & Following Scraper

The Apify actor [`apify/facebook-followers-following-scraper`](https://apify.com/apify/facebook-followers-following-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.335**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Extract data from Facebook pages and profiles about its followers and profiles it follows. Just enter the URL, and you'll get data such as follow type, profile's URL, image, title, and subtitle. You can integrate your workflow with tools such as Google Drive, Zapier, Make and much more.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Result $0.0082 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/facebook-followers-following-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-facebook-followers-following-scraper@0.0.335#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      startUrls: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `startUrls` | array | yes |  | Facebook URLs — Valid facebook page or profile URL |
| `resultsLimit` | integer |  |  | Results amount — If this limit is not set as many results as possible are returned |
| `followType` | string |  | `""` | Relation type — Select follows sub-section(s) |

## Output

Each dataset item is typed from the actor's published dataset schema. Every field may be null, and items may carry fields beyond these.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `facebookUrl` | string \| null | URL of the Facebook profile or page that was scraped. |
| `inputUrl` | string \| null | Input URL used to scrape followers or following. |
| `facebookId` | string \| null | Facebook ID of the source profile or page. |
| `followType` | string \| null | Type of relationship: 'followers' or 'following'. |
| `id` | string \| null | Facebook ID of the follower or following profile. |
| `followersId` | string \| null | ID used in the followers list context. |
| `followingId` | string \| null | ID used in the following list context. |
| `url` | string \| null | URL of the follower or following profile. |
| `image` | string \| null | Profile picture URL of the follower or following account. |
| `title` | string \| null | Display title or name of the profile. |
| `subtitle_text` | string \| null | Subtitle text shown below the profile name (e.g. mutual friends). |
| `__typename` | string \| null | GraphQL type name of the entity. |
| `__isEntity` | string \| null | GraphQL interface indicator for entity type. |
| `navSections` | array \| null | Navigation sections available on the profile page. |
| `pageAdLibrary` | object \| null | Ad Library information for the profile page. |
| `privacy_scope` | object \| null | Privacy scope settings for the profile. |
| `error` | string \| null | Error message if scraping this URL failed. |
| `errorDescription` | string \| null | Detailed error description if scraping this URL failed. |
| `profile_picture` | object \| null | Profile picture object. |
